sample.input: fixed token ids (LCG, seed 12345), real embedding rows, rms-normalised, times the layer's real norm gain

method.quantiser: libquant (rtn / gptq / cast) through tools/ernie55/iqr_probe: the converter's own quantise loop, the core's decoder
method.calibration_note: uncalibrated: identity Hessian (no ERNIE calibration Grams exist); GPTQ-class rules degrade to nearest-codeword trellis search. An upper bound on the error of a calibrated conversion (Radiance's 27B numbers: GPTQ is 20-40% lower than round to nearest)
method.reference: FP8 block dequantisation in f32 (e4m3 x ue8m0 scale, exact)
method.kld: KL(softmax(reference logits) || softmax(converted logits)), mean over 96 tokens; logit lens: block output -> rms -> model.norm -> real lm_head (201216 x 4096)
method.top1: argmax agreement of the same distributions
method.moe_note: MoE blocks route among the sampled experts (3 of 8 per token) with the real f32 routers, not 10 of 512
